blocks.title: What is this file?
blocks.what: A NodePool tells EKS Auto Mode which machines it may launch. It comes from the karpenter.sh/v1 API.
blocks.why: Auto Mode is built on Karpenter, which adds nodes when Pods need room and removes them when they do not.
blocks.ifRemoved: Kubernetes rejects the file, because it cannot tell what you want to create.
blocks.comment: Rules for the machines Auto Mode may launch

blocks.title: Give it a name
blocks.why: Pods can ask for this pool by name. Nodes it launches carry the name as a label.
blocks.ifRemoved: Kubernetes rejects the file, because every object needs a name.
blocks.comment: A name, which also labels the nodes it launches
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: flex

blocks.title: How to launch machines
blocks.what: nodeClassRef points to a NodeClass, which holds AWS settings such as subnets and the node role.
blocks.why: Auto Mode’s built-in NodeClass is called default. This block names its group and kind.
blocks.ifRemoved: Kubernetes rejects the NodePool, because it must name a NodeClass.
blocks.comment: Use Auto Mode’s NodeClass for AWS settings
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: flex
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeClassRef:
        group: eks.amazonaws.com
        kind: NodeClass

blocks.title: Which machine types?
blocks.what: The default NodeClass, and a first requirement: only c7i-flex.large or m7i-flex.large machines.
blocks.why: On the AWS Free plan, these are the only types Auto Mode can launch. They work on paid accounts too.
blocks.ifRemoved: Auto Mode may pick any supported type. A Free plan account cannot launch most of them.
blocks.comment: Use the default NodeClass, and only these two machine types
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: flex
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeClassRef:
        group: eks.amazonaws.com
        kind: NodeClass
        name: default
      requirements:
        - key: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type
          operator: In
          values: ["c7i-flex.large", "m7i-flex.large"]

blocks.title: On-Demand only
blocks.what: Use On-Demand capacity: a normal machine that AWS never takes back.
blocks.why: Spot is cheaper but can be taken back at short notice. Paid accounts can add it here.
blocks.ifRemoved: Auto Mode tries reserved capacity, then Spot, then On-Demand.
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: flex
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeClassRef:
        group: eks.amazonaws.com
        kind: NodeClass
        name: default
      requirements:
        - key: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type
          operator: In
          values: ["c7i-flex.large", "m7i-flex.large"]
        - key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type
          operator: In
          values: ["on-demand"]

blocks.title: Remove empty machines
blocks.what: WhenEmpty removes a node once it has run no Pods for one minute.
blocks.why: You stop paying for machines nobody uses.
blocks.ifRemoved: Auto Mode uses its default: it also moves Pods to pack nodes more tightly.
blocks.comment: Remove a node one minute after it becomes empty
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: flex
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeClassRef:
        group: eks.amazonaws.com
        kind: NodeClass
        name: default
      requirements:
        - key: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type
          operator: In
          values: ["c7i-flex.large", "m7i-flex.large"]
        - key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type
          operator: In
          values: ["on-demand"]
  disruption:
    consolidationPolicy: WhenEmpty
    consolidateAfter: 1m

blocks.title: A spending cap
blocks.what: All of this pool’s machines together may have at most 8 CPUs: four of these machines.
blocks.why: A limit stops a runaway app from launching many machines.
blocks.comment: At most 8 CPUs across the pool
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: flex
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeClassRef:
        group: eks.amazonaws.com
        kind: NodeClass
        name: default
      requirements:
        - key: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type
          operator: In
          values: ["c7i-flex.large", "m7i-flex.large"]
        - key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type
          operator: In
          values: ["on-demand"]
  disruption:
    consolidationPolicy: WhenEmpty
    consolidateAfter: 1m
  limits:
    cpu: "8"

blocks.title: An app for the pool
blocks.what: Three dashes start a second object: a Deployment called flex-web.
blocks.why: It shows Auto Mode launching a machine from this pool.
blocks.ifRemoved: Kubernetes rejects the file, because every object needs a name.
blocks.comment: A second object: a Deployment that uses the pool
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: flex
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeClassRef:
        group: eks.amazonaws.com
        kind: NodeClass
        name: default
      requirements:
        - key: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type
          operator: In
          values: ["c7i-flex.large", "m7i-flex.large"]
        - key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type
          operator: In
          values: ["on-demand"]
  disruption:
    consolidationPolicy: WhenEmpty

    cpu: "8"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: flex-web

blocks.title: Two copies
blocks.what: Keep two Pods, labelled app: flex-web.
blocks.why: Two Pods fit on one machine.
blocks.ifRemoved: Kubernetes rejects the file, because apps/v1 Deployments must have a selector.
blocks.comment: Two copies of the Pods with this label
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: flex
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeClassRef:
        group: eks.amazonaws.com
        kind: NodeClass
        name: default
      requirements:
        - key: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type
          operator: In
          values: ["c7i-flex.large", "m7i-flex.large"]
        - key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type
          operator: In
          values: ["on-demand"]
  disruption:
    consolidationPolicy: WhenEmpty
    consolidateAfter: 1m
  limits:
    cpu: "8"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: flex-web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: flex-web

blocks.title: Describe the Pods
blocks.what: The template gives each Pod the label app: flex-web.
blocks.why: The labels must match the selector.
blocks.ifRemoved: The Deployment would have nothing to create, so Kubernetes rejects it.
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: flex
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeClassRef:
        group: eks.amazonaws.com
        kind: NodeClass
        name: default
      requirements:
        - key: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type
          operator: In
          values: ["c7i-flex.large", "m7i-flex.large"]
        - key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type
          operator: In
          values: ["on-demand"]
  disruption:
    consolidationPolicy: WhenEmpty
    consolidateAfter: 1m
  limits:
    cpu: "8"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: flex-web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: flex-web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: flex-web

blocks.title: Run on this pool
blocks.what: nodeSelector asks for nodes labelled karpenter.sh/nodepool: flex.
blocks.why: Auto Mode labels every node with the pool that launched it.
blocks.ifRemoved: The Pods can run on any node, including the built-in pools.
blocks.comment: Only on nodes from the flex pool
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: flex
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeClassRef:
        group: eks.amazonaws.com
        kind: NodeClass
        name: default
      requirements:
        - key: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type
          operator: In
          values: ["c7i-flex.large", "m7i-flex.large"]
        - key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type
          operator: In
          values: ["on-demand"]
  disruption:
    consolidationPolicy: WhenEmpty
    consolidateAfter: 1m
  limits:
    cpu: "8"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: flex-web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: flex-web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: flex-web
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        karpenter.sh/nodepool: flex

blocks.title: What should run?
blocks.why: The nginx image runs on these Intel machines.
blocks.ifRemoved: Kubernetes rejects the Deployment, because its Pods would have nothing to run.
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: flex
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeClassRef:
        group: eks.amazonaws.com
        kind: NodeClass
        name: default
      requirements:
        - key: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type
          operator: In
          values: ["c7i-flex.large", "m7i-flex.large"]
        - key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type
          operator: In
          values: ["on-demand"]
  disruption:
    consolidationPolicy: WhenEmpty
    consolidateAfter: 1m
  limits:
    cpu: "8"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: flex-web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: flex-web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: flex-web
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        karpenter.sh/nodepool: flex
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: nginx:1.30.4

blocks.title: Size each container
blocks.what: Each container requests 250m CPU and 64Mi memory, with a 128Mi memory limit. This block makes the file ready.
blocks.why: Auto Mode picks a machine size from the requests. Resources go on each container, not on the Pod.
blocks.ifRemoved: Auto Mode cannot tell how much room the Pods need.
blocks.comment: Room each container needs, so Auto Mode can size the machine
blocks.yaml:
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: flex
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeClassRef:
        group: eks.amazonaws.com
        kind: NodeClass
        name: default
      requirements:
        - key: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type
          operator: In
          values: ["c7i-flex.large", "m7i-flex.large"]
        - key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type
          operator: In
          values: ["on-demand"]
  disruption:
    consolidationPolicy: WhenEmpty
    consolidateAfter: 1m
  limits:
    cpu: "8"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: flex-web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: flex-web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: flex-web
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        karpenter.sh/nodepool: flex
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: nginx:1.30.4
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              memory: 128Mi

notes.apiVersion: The API group and version. NodePools are in karpenter.sh/v1; Deployments in apps/v1.
notes.metadata: Details that identify the object, such as its name.
notes.---: Three dashes separate objects. One file can hold several objects.
notes.NodePool:kind: Rules for the machines EKS Auto Mode may launch.
notes.Deployment:kind: A Deployment keeps identical Pods running.
notes.NodePool:metadata.name: The pool’s name. Its nodes get the label karpenter.sh/nodepool: flex.
notes.Deployment:metadata.name: The Deployment’s name.
notes.Deployment:spec: The desired state of the Deployment.
notes.NodePool:spec.template: A template for every node this pool launches.
notes.spec.template.spec.nodeClassRef: The NodeClass with AWS settings, such as subnets and the node role.
notes.spec.template.spec.nodeClassRef.kind: NodeClass: Auto Mode’s kind for AWS node settings.
notes.spec.template.spec.nodeClassRef.name: default: the NodeClass Auto Mode creates for you.
notes.spec.template.spec.requirements: Rules a machine must meet. Each list item is one rule.
notes.spec.template.spec.requirements[].key: The machine property to check, as a node label.
notes.spec.template.spec.requirements[].operat: In: the property must be one of the values.
notes.spec.template.spec.requirements[].values: The allowed values for this property.
notes.spec.disruption: When Auto Mode may remove this pool’s nodes.
notes.spec.disruption.consolidationPolicy: WhenEmpty: remove nodes that run no Pods. Pods are never moved to save money.
notes.spec.disruption.consolidateAfter: Wait one minute after a node empties before removing it.
notes.spec.limits: The most this pool may launch, across all its nodes.
notes.spec.limits.cpu: At most 8 CPUs in total. Quotes keep it text.
notes.spec.replicas: How many Pods to keep running: two.
notes.spec.selector.matchLabels: Pods must have all of these labels.
notes.Deployment:spec.template: The Pod template: the blueprint for every Pod.
notes.spec.template.metadata.labels: Labels given to every Pod. They must match the selector.
notes.spec.template.metadata.labels.app: Every Pod gets the label app: flex-web.
notes.Deployment:spec.template.spec: What each Pod runs, and where.
notes.spec.template.spec.nodeSelector.karpente: Only nodes launched by the flex pool.
notes.spec.template.spec.containers[].name: The container’s name.
notes.spec.template.spec.containers[].image: The nginx web server, pinned to a version.
notes.spec.template.spec.containers[].resource: The CPU and memory this container needs and may use.
What the container is guaranteed. Auto Mode sizes machines from requests.
250m: a quarter of a CPU core.
The most the container may use.
At most 128Mi. Above it, the container is stopped and restarted.

tryIt.result: Creates the NodePool and the Deployment.
Lists flex beside the built-in pools, using the default NodeClass.
Pending at first. After a minute or two, a new machine joins and both Pods are Running.
One node shows flex, one of the two machine types, and on-demand.
Removes the NodePool and the Deployment. Auto Mode removes the pool’s machine too.
After a minute or two: No resources found. The machine is gone, and so are its charges.

questions.question: How do the flex-web Pods end up on this pool’s machines?
answers: Their nodeSelector asks for karpenter.sh/nodepool: flex
They run in the flex namespace
questions.explain: Auto Mode labels each node with its pool, and the nodeSelector asks for that label.

questions.question: Why only c7i-flex.large and m7i-flex.large?
answers: They are the only types Auto Mode can launch on the AWS Free plan
questions.explain: Auto Mode skips small sizes, and the Free plan allows only a few types. These two are in both lists.

questions.question: What stops this pool from launching many machines?
answers: limits: at most 8 CPUs in total
questions.explain: Once the pool’s nodes add up to 8 CPUs, Auto Mode launches no more from it.

fix.explain: WhenUnderutilized comes from Karpenter’s older v1beta1 API. The karpenter.sh/v1 API renamed it.
fix.fix: Use a v1 value. WhenEmpty keeps this lesson’s meaning.
